blockingModelErrorsFixed: AHI001 no longer defines free will as incompatible with prior causation.
SOI005 now targets special obligations (NE09) rather than collectivism (SO02).
Value-importance items use an importance scale rather than an agreement scale.
PLI005 uses ranking instead of a structurally attractive generic mixed option.
knownPoolLevelIssues: Primary-target wording remains strongly positive-keyed in the 60-item architecture pool.
Many constructs have only one prototype item and cannot support reliable scores.
The pool has not undergone respondent cognitive interviewing.
No item parameters, factor loadings, reliability estimates, DIF results, or validity evidence exist yet.
